notes.title: The Watchers prequel DEVOUR is Out Now!
notes.content:
Joe here from Straight Back Games. I'm really proud to share [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274570/DEVOUR/]DEVOUR[/url] with everyone here on Steam. Together with my close friend Luke, and the help of family and friends, we have created an online co-op horror experience for 1-4 players.

The game is available now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274570/DEVOUR/]on Steam[/url] for £3.99 / €3.99 / $4.99. Please check out our official release trailer if you haven't already!

[previewyoutube=mIridrRzU3w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About DEVOUR[/h2]

As once devoted cult members, players in DEVOUR must steel themselves and work together to stop their cursed leader Anna Puerta from unleashing an unspeakable evil. With the goat demon Azazel possessing her after a ritual gone horribly wrong, Anna’s rage and power will grow with every step the players take in DEVOUR. In a race against time, the players burn ritual goats, evade a growing legion of demons, and ultimately hope to break Azazel's hold over Anna. 
 
DEVOUR is all about escalating difficulty and scream-inducing jump scares. A player’s only means of defence in the darkness is a UV flashlight. AI behaviour, locked doors, and item placement are randomized, making players second guess each and every move. Luckily, they don’t have to face their fears alone with a built-in server browser and positional in-game voice chat. For those surviving DEVOUR without breaking a sweat, a Nightmare mode for the ultimate challenge is available. 
 
DEVOUR is a prequel to the previously released two-player co-op game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1112830/The_Watchers/]The Watchers[/url].
 
Follow the game on [url=https://twitter.com/DEVOUR_GAME]Twitter[/url], or join other fans on the dedicated [url=https://discord.gg/q4tTa2Z]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Play 1-4 player co-op horror survival game DEVOUR for free
notes.content:
[b]Calling all co-op horror fans![/b]

We're really pleased to bring you a free playable demo of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274570/DEVOUR/]DEVOUR[/url] during the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/steamgamefestival]Steam Games Festival: Autumn Edition[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688210/efdd08f966e03df7b8ac9e3dc179a753962e4e04.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274570/DEVOUR/]DEVOUR[/url] is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Stop a possessed cult leader before she takes you to hell with her. Run. Scream. Hide. Just don't get caught.

Recruit some friends and attempt to take on Anna in a generous portion of the game. Flying solo? Single player mode is also available - if you dare! DEVOUR is still under heavy development so we would love to hear your feedback and suggestions as we move towards its full release. 

Please join us in our [url=https://discord.gg/q4tTa2Z]Discord[/url] server and if you enjoy playing our demo, please consider adding DEVOUR to your Steam Wishlist.

Apply for Steam keys NOW to play in our closed beta 29th May - 31st May

The Watchers team is looking for players (PC only) to take part in the closed beta at the end of May for our upcoming 1-4 player survival horror game, The Watchers: DEVOUR.

Use the link below to apply, where you’ll be asked to join our Discord as well as fill out a quick form to request a Steam key. Note that each application is for one Steam key, so if you’re playing in a group, each person will need to request their own key:

The Watchers: DEVOUR can be played single-player, but ideally we are looking for groups of between 2-4 players to test the beta out for us and provide some feedback.

Any questions, don’t hesitate to ask.

Twitter: @TheWatchersGame

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.1.3

- Fix to prevent an exploitative method of solving Mask.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.1.2
notes.content:
We've listened to your feedback and made a few changes in our first post-release patch, v1.1.2.

[list]
[*] Improves Mask puzzle
[*] Fixes an issue where AI would sometimes see at an unintended angle
[*] Improves Japanese translation
[*] Fixes placement of Reset button in the keybinding UI
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: AI and server improvements
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has played The Watchers since the release. We've listened to your feedback and made a few changes in our first post-release patch, v1.1.1.

[list]
[*] Matchmaking improvements made by adding several new server regions
[*] Added Hint system. If you want, you can now get 1 hint for each object.
[*] Cultists have a lower detection radius for crouched footsteps
[*] Adjusted the audio effects for crouched footsteps
[*] Allow easier escape when leaving the Courtyard whilst carrying the Bowl
[*] Added a window to last part of Shoes puzzle to spot the Cultist in the closet easier
[*] Prevents "tap" moving behind the cultist in the Reading Room for the Ritual Book puzzle
[*] Steam Invites now work even if your server is password-protected
[*] Invert Mouse option added to settings
[*] A few object placement and lighting improvements
[/list]

notes.title: The Watchers is now available for purchase
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688210/9e94bf6f9e52983ecaefd0120580d1b0272e2ded.jpg[/img]

Thank you for waiting. We're pleased to announce that The Watchers has now been released!

You can grab it now on Steam with a 10% launch discount. So grab your smartest friend and get ready to face the wrath of Azazel.

To discuss The Watchers with other players, you can join in the conversation on our [url=http://discord.gg/eyZzB6c]official Discord server[/url].

We look forward to seeing you play as Luisa and Frederico in Coyote Valley soon!

notes.title: The Watchers will be released on February 6th
notes.content:
On February 6th at 9am PST (6pm CET) you will be able to purchase The Watchers on Steam. There will be a 10% launch discount, so be sure to jump in early with your partner of choice.

After a successful beta testing period in November, we worked through all of your feedback and proceeded to finalise the remaining puzzles. The game is packed full of content and has grown to be longer than we had originally anticipated. With that, we really hope you enjoy it!

If you're interested in playing The Watchers, please add us to your Steam Wishlist. You can also join in the conversation on our [url=http://discord.gg/eyZzB6c]official Discord server[/url].

We look forward to seeing you play as Luisa and Frederico in Coyote Valley soon!

[b]Update: [/b] The launch date was updated from Jan 23rd to Feb 6th. We want to make sure all translated versions of the game are also prepared in time and we'll need the extra days to test. Apologies but we want to make sure we give you all a great finished product!
